messages:
alex: heads-up — I'm handing the docs-sprint baton to maria for the next 48h. OOO starting tomorrow 9am PT. Will leave a short checklist in the sprint card :wave:

maria: got it. thanks! which high-priority broken links should I triage first?

alex: top 3: runbook anchors (specially the kv-cache guide), the runtime onboarding curl examples, and a staging image 403. I added links in the card and attached a grep export.

maria: perfect. can you DM the grep file location? also any PRs blocking the rollup?

alex: file is in /shared/docs/sweeps/links-2026-03-22.csv. Blocking PRs: #987 (runbook fragment), #992 (curl example update), #995 (image rehost). #992 needs a quick CR.

jamal: I can take #992 after lunch — should be a quick look. @maria can you add a short reviewer checklist in the PR (render locally, run snippet)?

maria: yes — adding checklist now. For local render I usually run:
```
npm run docs:preview -- --page runbooks/kv-cache
```
and a quick grep for anchors:
```
rg "#kv-cache" docs/ -n
```

jamal: great, thanks. FYI I'll ping in the PR thread when I'm done so we don't lose it.

sam: small ask — can we pin a temp owner for the staging image rehost? Ops might need to flip the CDN. If nobody volunteers, I can do it Tues.

maria: I can pick staging image rehost now. pinging ops channel after this to request temporary CDN override.

ops-bot: @maria — created ticket DOCS-421 for staging image rehost and assigned to ops-team. ETA 48 hours.

maria: lovely, thanks. last item — PTO coverage plan: alex will be OOO, jamal can cover quick CRs, i’ll do the ownership handoff and triage the sweep list. tagging @help if anything urgent pops.

alex: thanks team — leaving the sprint notes and a short rollback plan in the card. :thumbsup:

maria: copying checklist here for reviewers to reuse: 1) render page locally, 2) validate anchors with ripgrep, 3) confirm image loads in staging, 4) add minimal changelog line. I'll use that for all three PRs.

jamal: got it. will prioritize #992 then jump to #987 if time.

maria: closing loop — updated sprint card with assignees and ETA. ping me directly if you see anything with the pattern 403 or anchor mismatch, I'll triage immediately. :+1:
